cases.customer_question: Why can a Bluetooth SIG qualification account log in successfully but still be unable to use an already purchased Qualification Fee?
question_variants: Qualification Fee Receipt Number not found on account
Wrong Bluetooth SIG account owns the qualification fee
How do I transfer a Qualification Fee to another account?
Receipt Number belongs to a different user
Qualification submission account has no fee entitlement
cases.actual_issue: The Bluetooth SIG account provided for qualification activities did not possess the Qualification Fee Receipt Number because the fee was associated with a different user account that originally obtained the invoice.
cases.plain_english_explanation: A company may have multiple Bluetooth SIG user accounts. The account used for qualification work can successfully log in but still lack access to a purchased qualification fee if that fee is owned by another account. In this situation, ownership of the fee entitlement must be transferred before qualification processing can continue.
cases.consultant_answer: After confirming successful login, the consultant verified whether the account contained the required Qualification Fee Receipt Number. The Receipt Number was not assigned to that account, indicating that the invoice and fee ownership resided under a different Bluetooth SIG user. The consultant issued a Transfer Request and instructed that the owner of the Receipt Number accept the transfer through the Bluetooth SIG email workflow.
cases.decision_logic: Qualification fee entitlement is tied to the Bluetooth SIG account that obtained or owns the Receipt Number. If qualification work is being performed from a different account, the entitlement must be transferred through the official Transfer Request process.
cases.final_recommendation: Identify the account that owns the Receipt Number, complete the Bluetooth SIG Transfer Request acceptance process, and verify that the qualification account receives the fee entitlement before proceeding.
cases.risk_if_done_wrong: Qualification activities may be delayed because the working account cannot access the required Qualification Fee entitlement. Users may incorrectly assume there is a login problem when the actual issue is fee ownership.
